topic: Introduction to position lines, relative bearing, transit bearings, line features, and position lines from ground D/F stations and TACAN and VOR bearings.
syllabus_extract: Introduction to position lines, relative bearing, transit bearings, line features, and position lines from ground D/F stations and TACAN and VOR bearings.
specific_objectives: 14.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain and define a position on the earth.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB diagrams; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the definition of a position line?
How is relative bearing measured on an aircraft?
What is the difference between a D/F station and a TACAN station?

development.content:
Definition of Position Line
Relative Bearing Concepts
Transit Bearings Explanation
Line Features Characteristics

Ground D/F Station Position Lines
TACAN Bearing Position Lines
VOR Bearing Position Lines

Interpretation of Bearing Data
Fix Determination Basics
Error Sources in Bearings

summary_questions: Explain how a transit bearing is established.
Describe the primary difference between D/F and VOR position lines.
List three common sources of error in bearing measurements.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of position lines introduced in this lesson will be applied in the next lesson regarding circular and hyperbolic position lines.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to circular position lines, visual and radar range position lines and hyperbolic position lines, Introduction to the use of position lines for ground speed check, ETA check, track check, heading check and homing.
